chapters: Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Akâb gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Okôsiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak ga'ra' gu Samaria; gio ba' kua' ka'ook bhañ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon tu' no'ñ dhi' ko'kdai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; gio ba' bamii' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria daipu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhim cham va'k koi gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas ka't.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulh gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhañ ja'xñi; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon gu Por dhim cham va'k koi tɨɨda'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' ka't daakat gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tɨip mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jootom.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨip vaik mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mii' dhɨr vaik mambhɨɨx kɨkbok vupui bhaan gu Eliiyas bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' ka't vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu tai gu tɨkɨr tu' gook dharka' mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook dhim va'k koi tɨɨda'.

Jano' ba' jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gook oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' gu Okôsiias cham ga'ra' gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Okôsiias cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨkɨr gu Eliiyas bɨɨx gu Eliseeo gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Bet-el; mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'; gio ba' jix dhaav gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Bet-el gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; na gu' gu Eliseeo jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naaka'n gu suudai' maa'n gu ñi'ook jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' va'k ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨndak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' jix duñia' gook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk tu' na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' ka't jiimchu' a'gi'ñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai bɨɨx kavaayo gu tai jix ai'chdhix gook; gio ba' gu Eliiyas jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliseeo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu taat gu Israeel gu ja'tkam kavaayo cham pai' dhuuk jix ñi' jajannulhi'ñ gook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliiyas ka't gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliiyas ka't naaka'n gu suudai'; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas ka't gu suudai' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' jimchu' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo baasɨ'n gui'p; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Eliiyas jix utu'ñ bhaan gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jano' gu Jawatan; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' baas gu kavɨk; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' mɨjɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk suulh ka't jix duñia' gu Jerikoo; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' kiicham jix bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan tu'; gu' gu suudai' gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gamai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix buus; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' gu suudai' cham koi'm tu' ko'kdai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt moor gu ñi'ook kiicham bham; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x jix duñia' jix bhai'x jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' tɨɨgɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' moor gook gu kavɨk oo'm gook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Karmelo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Samaria bhaan gu Israeel oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ja'p gu taat gu naan; na gu' dhi' gu Baal gu taat ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat uañi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Mesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x ali' karneer gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chuukug bɨɨx.
Gu' gu' jix koi gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu Samaria gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't bhañ a'ga gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Moab jix aa'; na gu' tu jiim na gu' na ja'p tu'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p kavaayo gio kavaayo.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Idumea.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu gɨ'kora' gu Idumea; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu vaakax oi'ñchu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tɨɨgim gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu gɨ'kora' na ba' kɨɨsa' gu noobh gu Moabitas.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josapat; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'n tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat gu suudai' gu noobh gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Idumea.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ tu' bɨndak tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu taat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa'; jano' ba' cham; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu gɨ'kora' na ba' kɨɨsa' gu noobh gu Moabitas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' cham gu vupui gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham tu'.
Gu' gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Eliseeo.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' mumua'da'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham chɨgia' gu jɨvɨl tu' chɨgia' dhuuk dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhuup gu suudai' i'i gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' maa'n gio gu Moabitas gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx kiicham bɨx jix bhai' gu u'u bɨx suudai' buusñi gu suudai' bɨɨx gu jodai bɨx gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu maa'nkar tɨɨtɨs gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Idumea gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Moab na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan jum daa'ñ dɨr bɨx tu jiim jiix jix dhaas gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh gu tas bhaan gu suudai' gu Moab dɨr gu suudai' jix vɨgɨ na ja'p gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' gu kuchii gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n tu' jix koi duiñchu'; mi' dhɨr jano' gu Moab.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Israeel jix búup gu Israelitas tu' gu Moab jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan; gio ba' bhiadat cham gu ñi'ook gu Moab.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh bɨx dɨppɨr jix duñia' maa'n gu jodai jix bhuup; gio ba' gio bɨx suudai' buusñi gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨx jix bhai' gu u'u; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Kir-areset gu jodai; na gu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii na ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Idumea; gu' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkam mar ka't gu ñi'ook pai' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan vaak jodai; gio ba' ka't jix gɨ' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr suulh gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo bham; gio ba' tu duukam gu chio'ñ jix koi; mi' dhɨr tu' ñɨidhat tu duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix bhɨɨ gook gu ma'nkam tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Deklaarame gu ñi'ook gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan matgɨm juraa'n gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx cham.
Jano' ba' ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob bhaan tu' bhaan gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx kua' maa'n jix bhuup gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jootos bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu jix bhuup gu mar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaaso; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jano' ba' jix utu'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bi'iix bɨ'ñdhatu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sunem; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vaak jugi gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' mɨichdhai na ba' na pai' dhuuk daraibu' no'ch.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix koox.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Giesi jix duñia'; gio ba' mɨmɨim dhi' gu Sunamita; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jup tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Giesi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'ch bɨɨx bɨx dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Giesi jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham juraa'n gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham gu Jawatan gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham ja'tkam na tu juan.
Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo ka't tu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't jix gɨ' ka't gu tanoolh jix buus gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' mo'o jix aa' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu naan juruuñ daakat bhaan kɨkbok bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh jix koi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob jix buus.
Ba' jix aa' tɨɨt gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad tu' juanda'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jiim; na pai' dhuuk cham na ba' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ta'tak suudai' u'va gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu Karmelo; na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' jix duñia' gu Giesi; mi' dhɨr gu Sunamita.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu mar jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Giesi na ba' jix duñia'; gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhix cham tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar gu Jawatan cham tu ñi'ook tu' cham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Giesi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' oi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' cham tulhiiñdha'; jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' tu' tulhiiñdha' cham tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu naan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup chɨ'ɨɨk; gio ba' gu Giesi ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu' tu' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't na ba' gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' bham; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' tɨbiap gu Eliseeo gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi bhaan.
Jano' ba' baakɨk jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu chin bhaan gu chin gu vupui bhaan gu vupui gu noobh bhaan gu noobh; gio ba' bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak baasɨ'n mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan; gio ba' dhi' kɨɨv mui'kim jix kupi'ook gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Giesi; gio ba' mɨmɨim dhi' gu Sunamita; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt; jano' ba' baakɨk jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt tu' gu oidha'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu mar jix buus.

Jano' ba' gu Eliseeo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gilgal; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p bɨɨx jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix gɨ' gu vupui na ba' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix buus maa'n yooxi' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham bhai'x ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr na ba' gu chichio'ñ; gu' jugi mii' dhɨr jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios koi'm cham jugi.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ka't cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Baal-salisa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' kai' vaas tiriik jix vɨɨk; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ja'tkam na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu' a'ga; na gu' jix maa gu ja'tkam na ba' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan koi'mɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu Naamaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan jix duñia' na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix maa gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu Siria; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ gu' gakiidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Siria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook baabuk jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Israeel tɨɨyax; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu Naamaan.
Ba' jix aa' aapi'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Samaria dua'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' baakɨk gu Naamaan gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tɨɨyax gu oidha' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ta'tak baidhak mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix toja jodai jix bhai'x jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' tu' dhi' tu' jootsa' tu' tu duukam gu Naamaan na ba' dua'ñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu oidha' na ba' tu' gu chio'ñ dua'ñdha' gu Konsiderad jano' gu ñi'ook tu jiim bua' bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Eliseeo gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu Benga jano' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Naamaan bɨɨx kavaayo bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Eliseeo.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo bhañ mattuda' bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv mui'kim gu Jordaan gu chuukug tu' ka' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Naamaan ka't jix bhai'x bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' chɨtda na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr kua' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ pai' dua'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Abana gu Parpar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Damasko cham tutkɨ bɨx gu suudai' gu Israeel tu' cham jix duñia' gio na jix bhai' ka't jix bhai'x.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu taat tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' cham tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv mui'kim gu Jordaan jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chuukug na ja'p gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx chu'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' jano' kakasnira' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan dhi' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ cham pai' dhuuk.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Naamaan; na gu' jix duñia' cham maa'n tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na gu' jix duñia' tu duukam cham gu maa'nkar maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan ba'k vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon na ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu novɨ tu' gio vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon tu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Rimmoon gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr ta'tak jix jiim na ja'p gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Giesi jix duñia' gu Eliseeo gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan dhi' gu Siro gu Naamaan cham dhaagɨk gu novɨ tu'x ka't; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Giesi gu Naamaan; gio ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Naamaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan na ba' tu jiim jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' xoi'kam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; jano' ba' gu Miren tɨɨtɨs tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Epraim gook biipibop gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix toja jodai jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Naamaan; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gook cha'tmam; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook cha'tmam jix toja jodai gook jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas gook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't pai' ɨxchuixim jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu chichio'ñ bhaai'n.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu Eliseeo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Giesi jix aa'; jano' ba' tu duukam cham tu' matgɨm baasɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na pai' dhuuk cham ka't gio gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jix toja jodai jix bhɨɨ jajannulhi'ñ oidha' u'va kakneer gu vaakax tu duukam.
Jano' ba' dua'ñdha' gu Naamaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' jix buus vupui bhaan gakiidha' jix toja na ja'p jabook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gui'p gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jordaan maa'n pai'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' maa'n; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan jix duñia' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu u'u gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu' jix duu jix kavɨk jodai.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' ga'ra' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' pai' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' pai' na gu' gu Siros.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ mii' dhɨr pai' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' nukadham cham jix duñia' tu' gook.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; gio ba' tɨɨt tu duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham chɨkka gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Eliseeo gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook duukat na ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Dotaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook kiicham.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix buus ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' mia'n kiicham bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan chulhiiñchuda'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ba'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui; jano' ba' gu kavɨk ka't jix bhuup gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu tai xikoolh gu Eliseeo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Siros jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliseeo gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr naaka'n bɨɨx jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo; gio ba' cham dhi' gu bhóogɨt tu' dhi' kiicham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ gaagim; jano' ba' gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samaria gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui suulhgia' na ba'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't buupui gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Pon vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu suudai' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' jugi; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok bhañ suulh gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu Siria gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jum daa'ñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu Samaria ua'tulhdhidha' jix duñia' bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai'x jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook giokda' jixchamaam jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' bhɨi gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai gu u'vɨ jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' dodhia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios duukat tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' ulhña' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' jix maa jix bhai'x gu mar gu ñi'ook gu xibh jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix maa jix bhai'x gu mar; gu' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam gu mar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' jix kai gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' mo'o gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eliseeo daakat gu vaak bɨɨx mi'p daraa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu chio'ñ; gu' va'k mattuda' jix aa' daraa; na pai' dhuuk cham jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook dhi' gu mar mua'kam mo'o gu Mirad na pai' dhuuk daraibu' mattuda' ki'ñgob tu' ba'k; gio ba' cham jupaabkamu'n bhaan tɨroon tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx mattuda' tɨmñim; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n; jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kai' vaas ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't maakobh gu chichio'ñ tootolhidhat ba'k ki'ñgob gui'p maa'n; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baakɨi kiicham bhiogi' cham tu'x jai'ch kiicham koi; gio ba' tu' gio koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siros; jano' ba' tu' gu oidha' duaka'; gio ba' tu' koi'm koi.
Jano' ba' jix búup gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' na ba' jix duu yooxi' gu Siros; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tumiiñku dhi' gu Siros cham ka't gu chio'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Siros gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨroon kavaayo jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' bhaan no'ch gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos gu gɨ'kora' gu Egipkios na ba' bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook vaak zel kavaayo gu ñi'ook yooxi' na ja'p ka't; gio ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tootolhidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tumiiñku dhi' baap vaak zel koi'mɨk i'i jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' baap vaak zel gio jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p maa'n; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bhai' no'ch; jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jano' kapbhai' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jix maa jiiñak nuuka'n ki'ñgob kiicham gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Siros cham ka't gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook kavaayo gu ñi'ook gio gu ñi'ook yooxi' na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' gu tukaa' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Siros; mi' dhɨr tañia' bhiogi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak zel yooxi' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook kiicham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ko'iix ba'k kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n tu duukam; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jixchamaam kavaayo jix duñia' kiicham na gu' gio na ja'p bɨx gu Israeel tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gio na ja'p bɨx gu Israeel tu'; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gook kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan yooxi' gu Siros bham; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhuup jajannulhi'ñ gu Siros bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr suulh tu' jix duu maachim gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix buus jix duñia' yooxi' gu Siros; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kai' vaas jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas ki'ñgob mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ba'k jix koi jurtu'nka' ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaav.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kai' vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jix duñia' gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va; na gu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' bham; gio ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu vaak duaka' pai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨgim bhiogi' ɨlhdham gio bhaan gu oidha' kɨɨv.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix búup tu' jix duu na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ta'tak bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak jix oidha' gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu u'vɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus na ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Giesi jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx kɨɨ'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Giesi; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan dhi' gu u'vɨ dhi' gu mar gu Eliseeo jix duu duaka'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix duñia' bɨx gu i'bhɨ oi'ñga'n dɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu Eliseeo ka't gu Damasko gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't ka'ook jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨbiap.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu asael; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr no'ñ dhi' ko'kdai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu asael gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix bhai' gu Damasko oo'm jix ai gu ñi'ook jix buus; gio ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' bham; jano' ba' no'ñ dhi' ko'kdai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr ii'mdagaram; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui juruuñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu asael; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan jix aa'; na gu' tu' cham bhai' duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai biipibop koo'nda' a'aalh bhi'spio'kai.
Ba' jix aa' gu asael; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam gagai' dhi' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.
Ba' jix aa' ta'tak gu Eliseeo suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bhaan gu vupui gu Ben-adad jix koi; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu asael pai'.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Joram gu mar gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb na gu' mar u'vɨ gu Akâb ka't gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam na ja'p ka't jix duñia' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom bɨtaa'n gu novɨ gu Judaa jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Joram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Seir bɨx bɨɨx; gio ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' naaka'n gu Idumeos mia'n; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Edom gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Libna gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joram bɨx tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joram bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Okôsiias gu mar.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Okôsiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' oi'ñga' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Ataliia mar u'vɨ gu Omri gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Akâb tu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Akâb.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Ramot gu Galaad bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' gu Siros gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joram.

Na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesreel na ba' gu Siros jix duu vupui bhaan gu Ramot na pai' dhuuk bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; na gu' jix dhaav gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Jesreel na gu' ka't ka'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo jup tɨɨt maa'n gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ dhi' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu novɨ tu' gu Ramot gu Galaad.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josapat gu mar gu Nimsi; gio ba' baakɨk gu vupui jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan mo'o tu'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' Xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' na ja'p chɨbiapui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook no'ñ; jano' ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; gio ba' bɨx no'ch jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix búup chɨbiapui gu vaak; gio ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' Xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Akâb gu Jawatan na ba' tu' gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaak gu Akâb gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb bɨx na ja'p jix bhai'x gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Akâb na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia.
Jano' ba' gu Jesabel jugi gagai' yooxi' gu Jesreel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix kupi'ook ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Jeuu tu duukam gu Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨbiapui tu' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'p gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jano'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' Xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix dhaas maa'n bɨtaa'n atooxkor jix bhai'x gui'p; gio ba' gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josapat gu mar gu Nimsi bhaan gu Joram; gio ba' ka't gu Joram nukadham gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel kuiñcha gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.

Jano' ba' dua'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu Jesreel na ba' gu Siros gu ñi'ook bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; gio ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' aagak gu ñi'ook kiicham na ba' tu' gu Jesreel.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu Jeuu jix duñia' ka't gu Jesreel na gu' gu Joram ka't ka'ook; gio ba' gio gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joram.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhi'ñbak gu Jesreel jix ñi' gu Jeuu; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Joram jix aa'; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n kavaayo; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' ka't kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr mattuda' bɨɨx ka'm cham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio cham; na gu' gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jupaabkamu'n na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi na gu' jupaabkamu'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr ka't jix buus gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa maa'n moor gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Joram gu Jeuu; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesabel gu naan mumua'da'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Okôsiias; gio ba' gu Traikioon gu Okôsiias.
Gu' gu' gu Jeuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' naaka'n gu Joram tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeuu gu Bidkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨnkam gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel; na pai' dhuuk tu' tɨtda:―Aañ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Akâb gu taat gu Jawatan Dios dhi' bhaan bham.

Ba' jix aa' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu Nabot gu ɨ'ɨr gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu maa'nkar jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' bɨnkam gu maa'nkar jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu vaak u'uu pai'; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Jeuu bham; mi' dhɨr gio; jano' ba' gu Gur ju'ñdharan gu Ibleam; gio ba' gu Megiddo jix koi.
Jano' ba' tu duukam bhɨɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat tukga'n kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Okôsiias bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mi' dhɨr gu Jeuu gu Jesreel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bɨɨx mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuu ki'ñgob; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Simri mu'aa gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka tu jiim bhaan gook vaik.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ɨ'ɨr ka't kavaayo; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mi' dhɨr jix jugi jix i'i; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' mii' dhɨr; na mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu noobh.

Jano' ba' suulh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu duukam gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel jugi gagai' gu chuukug gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jesabel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak a'ga; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu Teniia gu Akâb gu Samaria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ua'na gu Jeuu bhañ gu Samaria gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel daraa gu ñi'ook gu Akâb bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan namki' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan namki' gu ja'tkam kavaayo kiicham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan atooxkor gu taat gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Gu' gu' chooto'n choo'n gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ a'ga gu Jeuu; gio ba' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix; mi' dhɨr cham gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na gookim jix duñia' bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk tu' gu Jesreel; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix oidha' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jekoliia gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel va'k jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salmanasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios; gio ba' gu Oseas ka't gu ñi'ook tu duukam namki'ñdha'.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu ñi'ook gu Oseas jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto cham namki'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria na ja'p oi'ñga'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria ta'tak bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Samaria juruuñ bhaan vaik.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu Oseas jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Samaria bhaan gu Israeel gu Asiria jix dhaas gu ala gu abor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Medos.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't u'u kavɨk vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duu.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jɨ'dɨlh dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨx jix bhai'x bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp ka't gu Jawatan Dios bhaan vupui bhaan tu' tu'x gu bhóogɨt na ba' daak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' tu juan duiñxim gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa gu novɨ bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨx bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tomaat gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' tattat gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k jix duñia' na ja'p tattat cham jɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat ka't bhaan; gio ba' bhiadat gu ñi'ook jix duu jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu chɨbɨɨp mi'p xikoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gio o'lhia bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gu Baal.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai; gio ba' jix maa jix duñia' kapbhai' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios daak.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu vupui; na cham gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' va'k ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu kai' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam do'ñcho gu noobh bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat; gio ba' gu Jeroboam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu vupui na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu novɨ bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel ka't bhaan gu oidha' gu Asiria bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu ja'tkam gu Babiloonia gu Kuta gu Aba gu amat gu Separbaim jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria pai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Samaria jix daa jɨ'dɨlh.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' jix daa cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'aa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; na gu' chɨbɨɨp tu' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria cham gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu oidha' tu' baas gu Matan na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix daa bhaan gu Samaria jix daa gu Bet-el gu ñi'ook jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ja'tkam kiicham pai' jix daa.
Jano' ba' gu Babiloonia jix duu gu Sukkot-benot gu Kuta gu Nergal gu amat gu Asima.
Jano' ba' gu ebeos jix duu gu Nibas gu Tartak; gio ba' gu Separbaim gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu tai gu Adra-melek gu Anamelek gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan chɨbɨɨp pai' jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na ja'p maa'n; na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' ñi'ook kavɨk tu' xoi'kam bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Jakob jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook jix maa ua'nak bɨɨx tas jix duñia' tu duukam cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' va'k jix duu bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp bɨɨma'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñxim; gio ba' gio gu ma'nkam bhaan jix duu tattat xoi'kam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu mar gu Akâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Abi mar u'vɨ gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' bapaalh gu ko'oi jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu Moisees na gu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Neustaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix dhaas nɨɨra; gio ba' mi' dhɨr tu' va'k cham ka't na ja'p bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx tu'x busaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria cham.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa gu ñi'ook dɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm kiicham.

Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salmanasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bhaan gu Samaria gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik; gio ba' dhi' xijumai oi'ñga' gu Esekîas ka't oi'ñga' gu Oseas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan gu Israeel gu Asiria jix dhaas gu ala gu abor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Medos.

Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios va'k jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' bɨx tu'x gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Lakîs; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa vaik cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas bɨx jix toja jodai ka't bakia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas dɨr gu Lakîs bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Tartaan gu Rabsaris gu Rabsakes bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr dhaibu jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix buus gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joa gu mar gu Asap.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' ja'xñi jano' gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chotdonɨt dhi' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' tu' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' dhi' gu Ejipto tu' oi'ñdha' ba'k gu novɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' bɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Esekîas tu' tu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' vupui bhaan dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' soi'ñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu' gook jix bhai'x kavaayo tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap tu' jano' cham gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias gu Sebna gu Joa gu Rabsakes; na gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' no'ch cham bɨɨx no'ch jix bhai'x maatɨt gu ja'tkam bhaan vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan tu' gu Jawatan na ba' a'ga dhi' gu ñi'ook cham va'k gu chichio'ñ bhaan vaak jodai na ba' jugi i'i gu suudai' tɨɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' kiicham cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas na gu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' maa'n jugi iigɨx maa'n i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ja'p gu oidha' kai'ñ suudai' u'va pai' gu takarui' pai' u'va pai' gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' duaka' cham koi; na pai' dhuuk cham gu Esekîas na gu' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Akaso oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu amat gu Arpad duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia' jix duñia' gu Samaria gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Jawatan Dios oidha' gɨ' tu' oidha' gɨ' gu novɨ na ba' namkidhat gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joa gu mar gu Asap tɨɨtɨs gu Esekîas jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix kai jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Eliakim gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos.
Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios gu Jawatan tu' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak; na ba' soi'm bakia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas.

Jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham jum i'obh gu ñi'ook naak bɨɨx jix duñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix maat gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rabsakes gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Libna; na gu' ka't naak ka't gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' jix kai a'ga gu Tiraka gu gɨ'kora' gu Etiopiia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bhañ gu Esekîas bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham tu' iatgi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' a'ga; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bɨx oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu Gosaan jix duu gu Resep gu ma'nkam gu Edeen mi'p gu Talasar.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu gɨ'kora' gu Arpad gu gɨ'kora' kiicham gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't jiñkai'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib tu' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' jix dhaas gu tai gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chichio'ñ gu u'u gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ na ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos bhañ a'ga gu Esekîas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria naak.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; mi' dhɨr tu' joi'mdak mo'o tu' mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix duñia' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨkka tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vupui bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu kakkavɨk gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham tu'x jai'ch; jano' ba' ba'k gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oidha' gu kavɨk gu Karmel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bɨɨx gu vaas tɨɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk naak jix jai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook jix ai ka't na ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu vaas yooxi' na ja'p gu vaas va'k jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus baakɨi i'iich bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' jix duñia' maatɨt tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat gu Esekîas; gio ba' dhi' oi'ñga' jugi gook oi'ñga'; mi' dhɨr vaik oi'ñga' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va jugi gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak gu Judaa tatk gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ jiix.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu kavɨk gu Sioon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ dhi'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' cham dhi' kiicham tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' ɨlhdham vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' ka't baas bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook cham dhi' kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham na ba' dodhia' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tukaa' jix buus nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' naaka'n yooxi' gu Asirios chamaam jix bhai'x jixchamaam jix bhai'x; gio ba' na ja'p jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria ta'tak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Niinibe pai' juruuñ.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Nisrok gu Jawatan Dios gu Adramelek gu Saresar gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu oidha' gu Ararat; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Esar-adoon gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas ka'ook koi'm suudai' u'va gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak na gu' koi cham ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' vupui bhaan tu' tu'r tu' bɨx bhai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'x tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas bɨɨx suanda'.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Isaiiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ naadat ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Esekîas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' naak soi'm buupui suakɨt; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh tu' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas ka't tu ñi'ook gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ɨkgiga'n mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix aa'; gio ba' buusnia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨkgiga'n mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu' ɨkgiga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Isaiiyas tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook ɨkgiga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix duñia' gu Akâs mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Berodak-baladaan gu mar gu Baladaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas na gu' ka't naak gu Esekîas ka't ka'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak tu'x a'bhar jix toja jodai jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu Esekîas cham gu vaak na ja'p bɨx aapi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gui'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ duukat tɨɨtɨs tu' gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨbiap gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bɨx ka't gu vaak; jano' ba' cham tu' cham.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh bɨx gu vaak bɨx tattat jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't baabuk gu Babiloonia cham gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas bɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' kiicham cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Esekîas bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Manasees gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem mambhɨɨx jixchamaam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu epsiba.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Esekîas gu taat ka't jix búup jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal tu' na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr mii' dhɨr tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai ka't tu' jix duñia' jix mui' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' daak.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak ka't gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas dhi' gu vaak gu Jerusalem bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' tɨɨt gu Israeel ka't joi'mdak gu oidha' tu' tattat bɨɨx jix duñia' xoi'kam jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x tu' jix duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu duukam gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Manasees cham bhai' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham.

Na gu' na gu' gu Manasees gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' bɨx jix duu gu Amorreos jix bɨɨx duu va'k gio tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Judaa duiñxim.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai' bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan gu Judaa jix duñia' maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Samaria gu vaak gu Akâb; gio ba' tu' gu Jerusalem na ja'p kutun kavɨk mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar kɨɨsa' gu noobh obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' ka't na ba' bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak dɨr gu tanoolh tattat moor gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mai' dhi' ja'aa gu Manasees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem; gio ba' uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duu uañi'ñ gu Judaa na ba' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manasees bɨx tu'x uañi'ñ cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manasees bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' u'uu pai' gu vaak u'uu pai' gu Ussa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amoon gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Amoon na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gook gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Mesalemet mar u'vɨ gu arus gu Jotba.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Manasees gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu taat jix jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix duñia' gu taat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat cham jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Amoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amoon cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' tukga'n u'uu pai' gu Ussa jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Josiiyas kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Idida mar u'vɨ gu Adaiia gu Boskat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas ka't bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sapaan gu mar gu Asaliia gu mar gu Mesullam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ilkiias gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ tu' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh xoi'kam gu ñi'ook namki' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu u'u gu jodai tɨ'ya' na ba' gu vaak.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ilkiias gu Sapaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gaagam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ilkiias jix maa u'uan gu Sapaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Ba' jix aa' bai'ñpu' gu Sapaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' dhagia' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook namki' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sapaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jix maa u'uan; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Sapaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' ka't naak gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu Akbor gu mar gu Mikâiia gu Sapaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asaiia tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Judaa gu ñi'ook dhi' u'uan tu' gaagam; na gu' jix gɨ' daak gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan bhaan no'ch na gu' taata'n tattat cham gu ñi'ook dhi' u'uan na ba' duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't ua'nak.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aikam gu Akbor gu Sapaan gu Asaiia gu ulda gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu u'vɨ gu Sallum gu mar gu Tikba gu mar gu Araas jix nukadham kutun gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gookim baasɨ'n kiicham tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi gu chio'ñ bhañ tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan gu ñi'ook maachim bɨx gu ñi'ook u'uan tu' jiñkai'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios daak bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' i'iich tu' jix duñia' bhaan dhi' pai' cham jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' gu ñi'ook u'uan.

Na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ gio tu' naak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx tattat tu' ka' gu ñi'ook tukga'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham gu vupui bɨx cham bhai' tu' bhaan dhi' pai'; gio ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ jum daa'ñ bɨx daraa gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa bɨɨx bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't jix duñia' gaagam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨt ju'ñdharan ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan mi'p ua'ñix mii' dhɨr u'uan; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ilkiias jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob jix buusñi vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jix duñia' na ba' gu Baal na ba' bɨx gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mai' gu Jerusalem yooxi' gu Kedroon tu' jix duu gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kamoreos gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa na ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa xikoolh gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Baal gu tas gu masad bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios mai' gu Jerusalem bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon oo' jix duñia' oo' bhaan pai'm gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu u'vɨ ga'n na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix ai bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kiki'ñgob mi'p ba'k ki'ñgob gu Josuee gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham mi'p gu novɨ o'nsop ki'ñgob kiicham.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan cham jix tɨ'ɨ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu' jugi gu takarui' cham jabka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
